12.t: Working with data: hormone and nerve responses
q: Pulling the hand from a hot pan (0.05 s).
Fill in "carried by" for the first and third responses.
Hand: nerves. Growth: hormones (growth hormone and sex hormones).
Compare nervous and hormonal responses, using the data.
Nervous: fast and short. Hormonal: slower and longer lasting.
Explain why hormones are slower than nerve impulses.
Hormones are carried in the blood to every organ and must reach and act on target cells; nerve impulses travel along neurones at up to 100 m/s.
